messages:
Priya (PM): quick async standup — rapid check before today's sync: what I shipped yesterday, blockers, and what I need today. TL;DR: spec v2 ready for review, need canary owner and a final UX approval.
Sam (Eng): did the backend gating work yesterday, merged draft PR but need one more review on the fallback policy. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/rw-infer/pull/4787
Megan (Design): looked at the spec screenshots — two tiny copy tweaks, added comments on the Figma file. no blockers from design, can sign off after those small changes.
Priya (PM): thanks @Megan — assigning you for final UX signoff. @Sam can you address copy or I can push a follow-up?
Sam (Eng): I can change the placeholder text in the template today, won't block the rollout. main blocker is infra capacity for the canary — need SRE confirmation on a 2-gpu pool for 48h.
Luis (SRE): I can provision a temporary 2xA10 pool in us-west1, ETA 2 hours. need the exact node labels and expected QPS.
Kazuo (Eng): expected qps ~150 req/s for initial canary, model variant q8_1. I'll post the service config in a sec.
Sam (Eng): config snippet: ```yaml
service:
  name: prd-infer-canary
  nodes: 2
  node_type: a10-gpu
  model_variant: q8_1
  routing: canary
```
Luis (SRE): got it. I'll tag nodes `env:canary` and `team:product`. will monitor and alert if CPU/GPU > 80%.
Priya (PM): decision needed: do we run canary tomorrow morning or today evening? leaning tomorrow morning to let design finish signoff and give on-call a heads-up. opinions? :thinking_face:
Megan (Design): tomorrow morning for me. better to validate with fresh eyes.
Sam (Eng): tomorrow morning works. I'll queue the rollout canary job and request the deploy window.
deploy-bot: staging deploy completed — `staging/prd-infer:canary` at 1769007820. logs: https://logs.redwood/abc123
Priya (PM): awesome. last asks: @Sam add a tiny rollback play (1-liner) in the PR, @Luis add a short alert doc link in the SRE channel, and @Megan drop a quick screenshot approval here when ready. otherwise we go tomorrow 10:00 PT. :raised_hands:
Kazuo (Eng): added rollback step to PR description.
Sam (Eng): added -> "If latency > 2s p95 for 5m, rollback to model v1.9". done.
Luis (SRE): created short runbook and posted in #eng-sre with link: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/canary-2026-03
Megan (Design): posted final screenshot and thumbsup.
Priya (PM): sweet. I'll follow up with calendar invite for 10:00 PT canary kickoff and post a quick checklist closer to the time. thanks team! :rocket:
